question: Which people did the spies say dwell by the sea and by the coast of Jordan?
explanation: The Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.

question: Which people did the spies say dwell in the land of the south?
explanation: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south.

question: Which people dwell in the mountains along with the Hittites and the Jebusites?
explanation: The Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains.

question: Why was the place called the brook Eshcol?
choices: Because a battle was won there
Because a spring rose from the rock there
Because of the cluster of grapes cut down there
explanation: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.

question: What did Caleb do before Moses when the people heard the report?
explanation: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it.

question: Why did the men who went up with Caleb say they could not go against the people?
choices: Because the LORD had left them
Because they were stronger than the spies
Because the Jordan was too deep
explanation: We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.

question: What did the evil report say the land does to its inhabitants?
explanation: The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof.

question: What did Moses tell the spies to be as they went?
explanation: Be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land.

question: Who was the spy from the tribe of Reuben?
explanation: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

question: Which spy came from the tribe of Issachar?
explanation: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

question: Which spy came from the tribe of Asher?
explanation: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

question: Which spy came from the tribe of Gad?
explanation: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

question: Which spy was sent from the tribe of Dan?
explanation: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

question: Which spy represented the tribe of Manasseh?
explanation: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

question: Which of these was one of the children of Anak at Hebron?
explanation: Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were.

question: Hebron was built seven years before which city in Egypt?
explanation: Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.

question: What kind of men was each tribe to send, according to the LORD?
explanation: Of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.

question: After going southward, what did Moses tell the spies to go up into?
explanation: Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain.

question: Besides whether the land was fat or lean, what did Moses ask them to learn about it?
choices: Whether there was wood in it
explanation: See what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not.

question: From which wilderness did Moses send the spies out?
explanation: Moses by the commandment of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran.

question: What did Caleb say the people were well able to do?
explanation: Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.

question: What did the spies say about the cities of the land?
choices: They were walled and very great
They were built upon the sea
explanation: The cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.

question: Which spy came from the tribe of Zebulun?
explanation: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

question: How did the congregation react to the spies' fearful report?
explanation: The people lifted up their voices, cried, and murmured against Moses and Aaron.

question: What did Joshua and Caleb do with their clothes when speaking to the people?
explanation: Joshua and Caleb rent their clothes in grief at the people's unbelief.

question: What did the people propose to do instead of going forward in faith?
choices: Make a captain and return to Egypt
explanation: In unbelief they wanted a leader to take them back to Egypt.

question: How many years would Israel bear its iniquities in the wilderness?
explanation: They would wander forty years, according to the forty days the spies searched the land.

question: What happened when the people tried to go up presumptuously after God's judgment?
choices: The ark led them to victory
They were smitten by the Amalekites and Canaanites
explanation: Going up without the Lord's presence led to defeat.

question: What did the people cry that they wished had happened to them?
choices: That they had stayed at Sinai
That they had never left Canaan
That they had been born kings
That they had died in Egypt or in the wilderness
explanation: They said, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!

question: Which two spies told the people the land was exceeding good?
explanation: Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, spake unto all the company, The land is an exceeding good land.

question: What did the whole congregation say to do to Joshua and Caleb?
explanation: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones.

question: What appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all Israel?
explanation: The glory of the LORD appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.

question: What did the LORD say He would do to the people with the pestilence?
explanation: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them.

question: Who pleaded with the LORD not to destroy the people?
explanation: Moses said unto the LORD, Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people.

question: Which spy did the LORD call 'my servant' because he followed Him fully?
explanation: My servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully.

question: How did the men who brought up the evil report die?
choices: By the plague before the LORD
explanation: Those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the LORD.

question: Which two of the spies lived still after the others died?
explanation: Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, lived still.

question: Against whom did all the children of Israel murmur?
explanation: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron.

question: What did Joshua and Caleb say the people of the land were for Israel?
explanation: Neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us.

question: What did Joshua and Caleb tell the people not to do against the LORD?
explanation: Only rebel not ye against the LORD, neither fear ye the people of the land.

question: What did the LORD ask Moses about the people's belief?
choices: How long will it be ere they believe me
Why will they not fear me
When will they build me a house
explanation: How long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?

question: Whom did the LORD offer to make into a greater and mightier nation?
explanation: I will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.

question: What did Moses say the nations would claim if the LORD killed all the people?
choices: That the LORD had abandoned Moses
That the LORD was angry at Egypt
That the LORD was not able to bring them into the land
That Israel had lost its king
explanation: Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them.

question: How did Moses describe the LORD when he asked for pardon?
choices: Swift to anger and slow to forgive
explanation: The LORD is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression.

question: How did the LORD answer Moses' plea for the people?
choices: I have pardoned according to thy word
Let them go back to Egypt
Wait seven days for my answer
explanation: And the LORD said, I have pardoned according to thy word.

question: Why would the LORD bring Caleb into the land?
choices: He was the oldest of the spies
He was the son of Moses' friend
He had another spirit and followed the LORD fully
explanation: My servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land.

question: Who dwelt in the valley when Israel was told to turn back?
explanation: Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.

question: By which way were the people told to get into the wilderness?
choices: By the way of the Red sea
explanation: To morrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

question: From what age and upward would those who murmured fall in the wilderness?
explanation: All that were numbered of you, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me.

question: Whom did the LORD say He would bring into the land, though the people said they would be a prey?
explanation: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in.

question: Why would the people wander forty years?
choices: One year for each plague of Egypt
One year for each of the forty days they searched the land
explanation: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities.

question: How many times had the people tempted the LORD, according to Him?
explanation: Have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice.

question: What did the people do early the next morning after hearing the LORD's sentence?
choices: They went up to the top of the mountain
explanation: They rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain.

question: How did Moses say the LORD went before the people by day?
choices: In a pillar of a cloud
explanation: Thou goest before them, by daytime in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.

question: The LORD forgives iniquity but visits the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto which generations?
explanation: Visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.

question: What did Joshua and Caleb say had departed from the people of the land?
explanation: They are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the LORD is with us.

question: The LORD swore that all the earth shall be filled with what?
explanation: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the LORD.

question: How did the people react when Moses told them the LORD's sayings?
explanation: Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.

question: What did the people say as they went up the mountain?
explanation: Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which the LORD hath promised: for we have sinned.

question: Why did Moses say they must not go up against the enemy?
choices: The LORD was not among them
explanation: Go not up, for the LORD is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.

question: Who did not depart out of the camp when the people went up the hill?
choices: The ark of the covenant and Moses
explanation: The ark of the covenant of the LORD, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.

question: Unto what place were the Israelites smitten and discomfited?
explanation: The Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, even unto Hormah.

question: What did the LORD say He would do to the people as they had spoken in His ears?
choices: He would forgive them at once
As they had spoken, so He would do to them
explanation: As ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you.

question: Moses said the nations had heard the LORD was seen how among the people?
explanation: They have heard that thou LORD art among this people, that thou LORD art seen face to face.

question: What did the LORD say the spies had brought upon the land?
explanation: The men which Moses sent to search the land... by bringing up a slander upon the land.

question: What did Moses and Aaron do before the assembly when the people wanted to return to Egypt?
choices: Lifted up their voice and wept
explanation: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation.

question: What did the LORD call the congregation that murmured against Him?
explanation: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me?

question: Why did the people say the LORD had brought them to the land?
explanation: Wherefore hath the LORD brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey?

question: When were the offerings described at the start of the chapter to be made?
choices: When they came into the land God was giving them
explanation: God gave these laws for the time when Israel came into the land He was giving them.

question: What offering often accompanied burnt offerings and sacrifices in this chapter?
explanation: The chapter details accompanying flour and drink offerings.

question: What was the rule for one who sinned presumptuously?
choices: That soul would be cut off
explanation: High-handed sin brought the penalty of being cut off.

question: What was a man found doing on the Sabbath, for which he was put to death?
explanation: The man was found gathering sticks on the Sabbath.

question: What were the children of Israel to wear on the borders of their garments?
choices: Fringes with a ribbon of blue
explanation: The fringe and blue cord were to remind them of the Lord's commandments.

question: What color of ribband were the Israelites to put on the fringe of their garments?
explanation: Put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue.

question: What happened to the man who gathered sticks on the sabbath?
choices: He was sent from the camp alive
He paid a fine of silver
The congregation stoned him to death
explanation: All the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died.

question: Where was the man stoned?
explanation: All the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.

question: Besides the native Israelites, who was to follow the same law?
choices: The stranger who sojourns among them
explanation: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.

question: Why were the Israelites to look upon the fringe?
choices: To remember the day of the Exodus
To remember all the commandments of the LORD
explanation: That ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the LORD, and do them.

question: How did the LORD describe Himself at the end of the chapter?
choices: The God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob
The Maker of heaven and earth
The LORD your God, who brought them out of Egypt
explanation: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God.

question: What did the LORD tell them to offer from the first of their dough?
choices: A cake, as a heave offering
explanation: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering.

question: Who makes atonement for the soul that sins ignorantly?
explanation: The priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, and it shall be forgiven him.

question: Where were the Israelites when they found the man gathering sticks?
explanation: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.

question: What did the LORD tell Moses to do about the man who gathered sticks?
choices: He must pay a double offering
He must be sent away for seven days
He must surely be put to death
explanation: The LORD said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death.

question: How much flour went with the meat offering for one lamb?
choices: A fourth part of an hin
explanation: A meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.

question: How much flour went with the meat offering for a ram?
explanation: For a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour.

question: How much flour went with the meat offering for a bullock?
explanation: With a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.

question: What was the whole congregation to offer if they sinned by ignorance?
choices: One young bullock for a burnt offering
explanation: All the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, with one kid of the goats for a sin offering.

question: Along with the bullock, what else did the congregation bring for a sin offering?
explanation: One kid of the goats for a sin offering.

question: Why was the man who gathered sticks put in ward?
choices: It was not declared what should be done to him
explanation: They put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.

question: What did the LORD say the soul that sins presumptuously does?
explanation: The soul that doeth ought presumptuously, the same reproacheth the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off.

question: What would the Israelites be as they remembered the commandments?
explanation: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.

question: Who stoned the man with stones outside the camp?
explanation: All the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones.

question: When were the Israelites to offer up a heave offering of dough?
choices: When they ate of the bread of the land
When the first lamb was born
explanation: When ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the LORD.

question: How long was the ordinance for the stranger and the congregation to last?
explanation: One ordinance shall be both for you and for the stranger, an ordinance for ever in your generations.

question: Who was forgiven along with the congregation when all the people were in ignorance?
explanation: It shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them.

question: What should the fringes help Israel not to seek after?
choices: Their own heart and their own eyes
explanation: That ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring.

question: What was an individual to bring if he sinned through ignorance?
choices: A she goat of the first year
explanation: If any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.

question: What was done with a drink offering for one lamb?
choices: A fourth part of an hin of wine was prepared
A tenth deal of wine was poured
Half an hin of oil was used
A third part of an hin of wine was used
explanation: The fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare for one lamb.

question: How much oil was mingled with the flour for a ram's meat offering?
choices: The third part of an hin
The fourth part of an hin
explanation: Two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.

question: How much oil was mingled with the flour for a bullock's meat offering?
choices: The fourth part of an hin
The third part of an hin
explanation: Three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.

question: How much wine was the drink offering for a bullock?
choices: The fourth part of an hin
The third part of an hin
explanation: Thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine.

question: How much wine was the drink offering for a ram?
choices: The fourth part of an hin
The third part of an hin
explanation: For a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine.

question: What did the LORD say the presumptuous soul had despised?
explanation: Because he hath despised the word of the LORD, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off.

question: What did the LORD say would be upon the presumptuous soul that is cut off?
explanation: That soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.

question: The cake of the first dough was to be lifted like the heave offering of what?
explanation: As ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.

question: Which four animals did the LORD name for the offerings done in this manner?
choices: A bullock, a goat, a dove, or a pigeon
A bullock, a ram, a lamb, or a kid
A ram, a heifer, a lamb, or a dove
A lamb, a kid, a turtledove, or a bullock
explanation: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.

question: Who brought the man to Moses and Aaron and all the congregation?
choices: Those who found him gathering sticks
explanation: They that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.

question: On what day did the man gather sticks?
explanation: They found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.

question: What sort of offering did the LORD call the offering by fire?
choices: A sweet savour unto the LORD
explanation: To make a sweet savour unto the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock.

question: After the priest made atonement for the congregation sinning in ignorance, what would follow?
explanation: The priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation, and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance.

question: What did the LORD tell Moses to bid Israel make in the borders of their garments throughout their generations?
explanation: Bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations.

question: What kind of offering did they bring along with the burnt offering besides the drink offering?
choices: A meat offering of flour mingled with oil
explanation: Bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.

question: The sin-of-ignorance commands counted from which day onward?
choices: The day the LORD commanded Moses
The day the tabernacle was set up
explanation: All that the LORD hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the LORD commanded Moses, and henceforward.

question: Who led the rebellion against Moses and Aaron?
explanation: Korah joined with Dathan and Abiram in rebellion.

question: What did the rebels accuse Moses and Aaron of?
explanation: They said Moses and Aaron exalted themselves above the congregation.

question: What unusual judgment came upon Dathan and Abiram and their households?
choices: The earth opened and swallowed them
explanation: The ground split open and swallowed them alive.

question: What happened to the 250 men who offered incense?
choices: Fire came out from the Lord and consumed them
explanation: Fire from the Lord consumed the 250 men offering incense.

question: How was a plague stopped when wrath went out against the congregation?
choices: Aaron ran with incense and stood between the dead and the living
explanation: Aaron made atonement with incense and the plague was stayed.

question: What did Moses do when he heard the rebels' complaint?
explanation: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face.

question: How many princes of the assembly rose up with Korah?
explanation: Certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown.

question: What did Moses tell Korah and his company to take and put fire in?
explanation: Take you censers, Korah, and all his company; and put fire therein.

question: From which tribe was Korah?
explanation: Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi.

question: Which priest took up the censers out of the burning?
explanation: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning.

question: What did Dathan and Abiram say when Moses sent to call them?
explanation: Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram: which said, We will not come up.

question: What did Israel round about do when the earth swallowed Korah's company?
explanation: All Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them.

question: What was made from the brasen censers?
choices: Broad plates for a covering of the altar
explanation: The censers were made broad plates for a covering of the altar.

question: What did the congregation say to Moses and Aaron the next day?
choices: Ye have led us back to Egypt
Ye are the chosen of the LORD
Ye have made us a nation
Ye have killed the people of the LORD
explanation: On the morrow all the congregation murmured, saying, Ye have killed the people of the LORD.

question: How many died in the plague, besides those in the matter of Korah?
explanation: They that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.

question: What did Dathan and Abiram say Moses had brought them up out of?
choices: A land that floweth with milk and honey
explanation: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness?

question: What did Moses say the rebels sought in addition to their service at the tabernacle?
explanation: He hath brought thee near to him: and seek ye the priesthood also?

question: What did Moses say he had not taken from the rebels?
explanation: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.

question: What did Moses ask the LORD about the rebels' offering?
explanation: Moses said unto the LORD, Respect not thou their offering.

question: What did the LORD tell Moses and Aaron to do from among the congregation?
choices: Separate themselves so He could consume them in a moment
explanation: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.

question: How did Moses and Aaron address God when pleading for the congregation?
choices: O God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob
O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh
explanation: They fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?

question: What did Moses say the people should not do with the possessions of the wicked men?
explanation: Depart from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.

question: What would prove that the LORD had not sent Moses?
choices: If the men died the common death of all men
explanation: If these men die the common death of all men... then the LORD hath not sent me.

question: What sign did Moses say would show the men had provoked the LORD?
choices: The earth would open and swallow them alive
explanation: If the LORD make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up... they go down quick into the pit.

question: Who stood in the door of their tents with Dathan and Abiram?
choices: Their wives, sons and little children
explanation: Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.

question: What came out from the LORD and consumed the two hundred and fifty men?
explanation: There came out a fire from the LORD, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.

question: Why were the brasen censers made into a covering for the altar?
choices: As a gift for the tabernacle builders
No stranger, not of Aaron's seed, may offer incense
explanation: A memorial that no stranger, which is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before the LORD.

question: What did Moses tell Aaron to take to make an atonement for the people?
choices: A censer with fire from the altar and incense
explanation: Take a censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and make an atonement for them.

question: What did Aaron do to stop the plague?
choices: He stood between the dead and the living
He sprinkled blood on the door
explanation: He stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

question: Where did the glory of the LORD appear when Korah gathered the congregation?
choices: At the door of the tabernacle
explanation: Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the congregation.

question: Who was Korah's father?
explanation: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi.

question: Who was the father of Dathan and Abiram?
explanation: Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab.

question: Which man, son of Peleth, joined Korah in the rebellion?
explanation: And On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men.

question: From which tribe were Dathan, Abiram and On?
explanation: Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben.

question: What did the rebels say about all the congregation?
choices: That all are holy, and the LORD is among them
That all are priests of the LORD
That all are chosen to rule
That all are free from sin
explanation: Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the LORD is among them.

question: What did Moses say the LORD would do the next day?
choices: Show who are His and who is holy
explanation: Even to morrow the LORD will shew who are his, and who is holy.

question: Who was told to bring his censer before the LORD along with Korah's company?
explanation: Thou also, and Aaron, each of you his censer.

question: Who followed Moses when he went to Dathan and Abiram?
choices: The two hundred and fifty princes
explanation: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

question: What did Moses say proved he had not acted of his own mind?
choices: The LORD had sent him to do all these works
explanation: Hereby ye shall know that the LORD hath sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of mine own mind.

question: Why did all Israel flee from the cry of the swallowed men?
choices: Lest the earth swallow them up also
explanation: They said, Lest the earth swallow us up also.

question: What did the LORD call Korah's company, whose censers were hallowed?
explanation: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates.

question: What did Eleazar do to the fire from the censers?
choices: He carried it to the altar
He covered it with the plates
explanation: Take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.

question: What covered the tabernacle when the congregation gathered against Moses and Aaron the second time?
explanation: They looked toward the tabernacle: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the LORD appeared.

question: How did Aaron go to the congregation with the censer?
choices: He ran into the midst of them
explanation: Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation.

question: What did Moses tell the sons of Levi was a small thing in comparison with seeking the priesthood?
choices: That God had given them cities
That God had spared them in Egypt
